sentence: The NHS says blood pressure can be checked at home with a monitor, with the cuff on the upper arm and the person sitting with their back supported; local NHS leaflets also advise avoiding caffeine and smoking beforehand.

sentence: Blood pressure is written as two numbers, the first higher than the second.
